items.title: The three regular-immersion flavours coincide for immersions into locally Noetherian spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces with X locally Noetherian, the lemma proves Koszul-regular if and only if H_1-regular if and only if quasi-regular — the Noetherian collapse of the regularity zoo on the spaces side. The retained proof is written as the definitional transfer: the chapter's Definition definition-regular-immersion defines each flavour etale-locally by the corresponding scheme-theoretic notion (referencing the locally Noetherian dictionary section of Properties of Spaces for the hypothesis transfer), so the assertion is exactly the schemes theorem Divisors, lemma regular-immersion-noetherian transported through the definitions. Retained author proof at lines 10574-10581.
